summary: The note describes Community Learning Centers (CLCs) in Somerville, which blend academic learning with cultural enrichment and skill-building by drawing on local resources. It covers partnerships with artists, a community asset mapping initiative, the TechConnect program, adult education, and reported outcomes. It closes with the January 2024 conference on replicating the Somerville model elsewhere and the CLC philosophy of balancing roots and wings.
one_line: Somerville's Community Learning Centers partner with local artists, experts and tech firms to deliver broad education, and the model is being studied for replication.
key_facts: Community Learning Centers (CLCs) blend academic learning with cultural enrichment and skill acquisition by harnessing local community talent and resources.

The Somerville Community Learning Center and the Somerville Art Collective announced a partnership on September 15th, 2023, bringing artists James Harrington and Maria de Los Angeles together with educators to integrate an arts curriculum.
Arts workshops under the partnership range from pottery making to theater production.
Director Eliot Thompson led the Somerville Learning Center in launching an initiative on November 1st, 2023, to map community assets and engage them in the curriculum.
Historian Jonathan Myers leads guided walks through heritage sites, and culinary expert Rosa Martinez adds culturally diverse healthy cooking to nutrition classes.
The 'TechConnect' program began on December 12th, 2023, to bridge the digital divide with access to high-tech resources and instruction.
TechConnect partners with local tech firms and start-ups; software engineer Priya Anand leads coding workshops, and the program may lead to internships and job placements.
Adult education at CLCs covers professional development, language skills and financial literacy, with remarkable participation since October 2023.
Financial advisor Alex Keaton has held several personal finance seminars since early November 2023.
The Somerville CLC saw a significant uptick in school attendance and community engagement after integrating local resources.
Curriculum coordinator Jessica Lin said assessments show students in these programs have higher understanding and retention of material.
The Somerville CLC hosted a conference on January 20th, 2024, to share best practices and plan extending the model to other regions; tech mogul Sandra Chen expressed support.
